title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of SechKAN on 1D Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.25876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The connection between the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem (KART) and neural network design has led to the development of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), with applications ranging from STEM problems to AI tasks. In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of a KAN variant, SechKAN, which relies on hyperbolic secant (sech) functions as basis functions, with a 1D projection to reduce the number of parameters to a level comparable to MLPs. We evaluate SechKAN on three 1D classification datasets: UCI Human Activity Recognition (UCI HAR), ElectricDevices, and Crop, and compare it with several effective networks, including EfficientKAN, MLP, CNN1D, ResNet1D, and DSCNN1D, using approximately comparable parameter budgets. The results indicate that SechKAN achieves competitive performance across the three datasets, with particularly strong performance on Crop. translated_title: 评估SechKAN在一维数据上的有效性
translated_abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理（KART）与神经网络设计之间的联系催生了Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的发展，其应用范围涵盖从STEM问题到AI任务等多个领域。在本文中，我们研究了一种KAN变体——SechKAN的有效性，该变体采用双曲正割函数作为基函数，并通过一维投影将参数数量减少到与MLP相当的水平。我们在三个一维分类数据集上对SechKAN进行了评估：UCI人体活动识别（UCI HAR）、ElectricDevices和Crop，并在大致相当的参数预算下，将其与多种高效网络进行比较，包括EfficientKAN、MLP、CNN1D、ResNet1D和DSCNN1D。结果表明，SechKAN在三个数据集上均取得了具有竞争力的性能，其中在Crop数据集上表现尤为突出。消融研究进一步表明，网格大小和归一化会影响性能（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种以双曲正割函数为基函数、通过一维投影将参数量降至与MLP相当水平的KAN变体SechKAN，实验表明其在三个一维分类数据集上均具有竞争力，尤其在Crop数据集上表现突出。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates SechKAN, a KAN variant using hyperbolic secant basis functions with a 1D projection to achieve MLP-comparable parameter counts, demonstrating competitive performance across three 1D classification datasets with particularly strong results on Crop.
